note: note des événements postérieurs du 10-Q d'AMD du 5 novembre 2025 (trimestre clos le 27 septembre 2025) : bon du 5 octobre 2025 sur jusqu'à 160 millions d'actions à 0,01 $, exerçable jusqu'au 5 octobre 2030, acquis par tranches selon des seuils d'achats de GPU et des cours cibles ; classement attendu en passif, juste valeur à la date d'attribution portée en réduction du revenu à mesure de sa comptabilisation, réévaluation à chaque clôture en autres produits
quote: On October 5, 2025, the Company issued to OpenAI OpCo, LLC (the Warrantholder) a warrant to purchase up to an aggregate of 160 million shares of the Company's common stock at an exercise price of $0.01 per share. The warrant shares will vest in tranches based on certain GPU purchase milestones by the Warrantholder, or its affiliates, or indirectly through third parties, and achievement of specified Company stock price targets and stock performance. Each vested tranche is further subject to the fulfillment of certain other technical and commercial conditions prior to exercise. Subject to certain terms and conditions, the warrant is exercisable through October 5, 2030. The Company expects to account for the warrant as a liability-classified financial instrument, unless the conditions for equity classification are satisfied. The grant date fair value of the warrant will be recognized as a reduction to revenue when revenue is recognized. The warrant, when classified as a liability, will be remeasured at fair value at each reporting period, with changes in fair value to be recorded within Other income (expense), net.

note: réalisation le 27 octobre 2025 de la cession de l'activité de fabrication de ZT Systems à Sanmina : 2,4 Md$ en numéraire, sous réserve d'ajustements, et 1 151 052 actions Sanmina ; complément conditionnel jusqu'à 450 M$ ; accord coté depuis le 8-K de mai 2025 (même instrument)
quote: On October 27, 2025, the Company completed the sale of the ZT Manufacturing Business to Sanmina for 1,151,052 shares of Sanmina common stock and $2.4 billion in cash, subject to certain purchase price adjustments. The Company is eligible to receive additional cash consideration of up to $450 million to the extent certain conditions are met following the close of the sale.
